description: Reconcile a saved-card purchase by the order_id returned from purchase with payment_method=stripe_off_session. For this machine's order, check Stripe PaymentIntent ownership and status; the operation can resume an idempotent pending charge, complete verified fulfilment, or return a required Stripe.js/3-D Secure action. Do not retry with a new order or bypass bank authentication; use get_order to read ordinary delivery status.

order_id.description: Order ID returned by the machine's stripe_off_session purchase.
